risks.risk: Motor or pump failure (unit hums but doesn't spray or is dead).

risks.risk: Internal seals are blown causing low pressure or leaking from the housing.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with the trigger released to check for bypass leaks.
risks.if_unproven: as a unit with a damaged pump.

risks.risk: High-pressure hose is punctured or kinked.
risks.proof: A photo of the high-pressure hose fully uncoiled.
